criteria.description: Identifies the approved decision and the unapproved later discussion correctly.
Requires the Delta checklist for current publication.
Preserves the approval boundary between a decision and a discussion.
Does not promote the newer discussion into a replacement rule.
Cites the actual approved-decision and discussion sources used.
Identifies the 30-day replacement as current and the 14-day rule as historical.
Uses 30 days for current bundle retention.
States the replacement direction from the old rule to the current rule.
Does not let the old retention rule guide current cleanup.
Cites the actual old-rule and replacement sources used.
Identifies both cache observations as incompatible and unresolved.
Proposes a controlled comparison with matched workload variables.
Preserves uncertainty while dataset size and worker count differ.
Does not silently select either refresh interval.
Cites the actual conflicting observation sources used.
Identifies the distinct current macOS and Win11 preview rules.
Uses Quartz on macOS and Direct on Win11.
Keeps the Quartz decision within its macOS scope.
Does not generalize Quartz to Win11 or globally.
Cites the actual macOS and Win11 boundary sources used.
Identifies the single-retry rule as established and the third-retry result as one-off.
Retries once, then stops and records a repeated failure.
Requires controlled repetition and approval before a rule change.
Does not promote the one-off result into a three-retry rule.
Cites the actual stable-rule and one-off observation sources used.
